value.rationale: Near-orthogonality probability under physically canonical harmonic dynamics is the exact operational statistic identified as important in the motivating paper. The closed single integral replaces three-level numerics, and the nontrivial sharp 7/3 law distinguishes the central-strip and off-axis zero branches. It gives exact calibration of the rare-event regime and a physically meaningful comparison to complex Haar qubits; it is not a routine textbook corollary.
